request_summary.last_message: {"content":"Organisation: acme-001. Admin role: it_admin.\n\nRequest: M4XVHUV1MEPZ keeps running out of memory. Order whatever upgrade it needs.","role":"user"}

content.text: {"intent":"action","restated_question":"Confirm whether device M4XVHUV1MEPZ in acme-001 is under memory pressure, using the policy's ram_pressure threshold and the ram_pressure detector over the 30-day window. If it is, propose the appropriate upgrade order (e.g. a RAM upgrade, or a replacement if the model cannot be upgraded) for human approval.","assumptions":["'Keeps running out of memory' means sustained memory usage above the policy's ram_pressure threshold, as determined by the ram_pressure detector rather than manual calculation.","The upgrade will only be proposed via create_upgrade_order and requires human approval; nothing is ordered automatically.","The type of upgrade depends on the device's model and current RAM from telemetry; if the hardware cannot be upgraded, flagging it for replacement may be proposed instead.","If telemetry does not show sustained memory pressure, the plan will report that and not propose an order."],"steps":[{"tool":"get_device","purpose":"Retrieve M4XVHUV1MEPZ's current snapshot: model, installed RAM, memory %, OS and owner."},{"tool":"get_policy","purpose":"Get the ram_pressure threshold and definition used to judge memory pressure."},{"tool":"run_insights","purpose":"Run the ram_pressure detector to confirm whether this device has consistent memory pressure over the 30-day window."},{"tool":"create_upgrade_order","purpose":"If pressure is confirmed, propose a RAM upgrade order for M4XVHUV1MEPZ for admin approval, with the supporting evidence attached."}],"may_propose_actions":true,"out_of_scope_reason":""}
